reviews.title: Best looking 360mm aio for its price range
reviews.comment:
First and foremost, price to performance is craaazy. 360mm aio with an led for around $100 is awesome already. Keeps my ryzen 9900x nice and cool while looking awesome doing it. The ONLY thing I think that could make this cooler better  is if the screws to mount the fans to the radiator were a little longer so you can mount the fans on the back of the radiator and to the case just to make it more structurally sound when running 3 rear and 3 front mounted fans like I did for max airflow, but it does still reach just not as much as I would like, but because that's an opinion based thing I'm not gonna take a star off. No issues installing it, nice and simple, but to fair I put it in one of the biggest cases on the current market so your experience may vary. So far I trust the reliability of the cooler since it is keeping my cpu temps low and consistent and at idle it's nice and quiet. I'll be looking forward to many other builds using this cooler in the future!
P.s. I used the triple fan on the rear of the radiator for better airflow. The fans you see in my picture are also thermalright but they are the TL-C12CW-S
Full build:
Ryzen 9900x
Rx 6900 xt
Gigabyte b850 aorus elite wifi7 ice
Vetroo 1000w psu
Corsair vengeance ddr5 32gb 6000mt/s
6tb total m.2 nvmes
Thermalright professional vision 360 mm aio
HYTE y70 atx case
8x thermalright argb fans
Asiahorse white cable extensions.
reviews.author: Brenton Boone

reviews.title: The best AIO CPU cooler for the price I've ever seen. GJ Thermalright!
reviews.comment: I've been a PC builder for decades now and have seen cooling trends come and go. This company has found the sweet spot bridging performance, price, and looks IMHO. I'm happy to have bought this as it is fantastic for the price, was easy to install and looks amazing in my build. It's a stunner, whenever anyone has seen it I get complements and questions about the  big vibrant screen. This particular AIO is used to cool an AMD 9800x3D and it does it incredibly well. I have 3 PCs and all three have Thermalright fans, fan/RGB lighting control hubs, and two have the AIOs. All of them stay cool and look cool. For now Thermalright is my go to for PC cooling when it comes to AIOs and case fans because their products meet and exceed my needs for a great price and they look fantastic as well.
reviews.author: SinSear001

reviews.title: Great AIO, terrible software.
reviews.comment:
Small future edit (after using it for 2 months)
Screen goes dark after a couple of power cycles. Not sure what causes it but unplugging and replugging the screen helps it go back to normal. A bit annoying since I have a HAVN HS 420 case and I have to take apart a few things just to get inside.
I was able to get the saved theme corrected, but it was a bit of pain to figure it out since there isn't anywhere in the manual or online on how to save a theme, but I will bring my score up a star, only because of the screen going dark on occasion.
Overall still a great choice in AIO for the money, I still recommend.
*review after using it a week*
The aesthetics are great.
I wanted an AIO with a screen and I like minimal RGB so this was right up my alley.
I personally never used an AIO before, and I decided to get this when there was a prime day deal going on for it. For the money I paid for it, it was a great deal at the time, and even now too.
Installing was easy, although I had to bend the mounts a bit since it was bowed out too much to reach the screws properly. Pump is a little louder than I was expecting but still quiet enough.
Temps are good on my AMD 7700.
My only big gripe with this AIO is the software. I am almost to the point where I want to just run it without the screen, or just outright replace the whole thing with a peerless assassin. I can't seem to save any of the custom themes I want, every time I boot up my PC, I have to reconfigure the whole thing to how I want to look. If it wasn't for that, this AIO would be getting a full 5 stars.
reviews.author: Jesus Garcia

reviews.title: CPU cooler GOOD but LCD DIED
reviews.comment: The CPU cooler is very beautiful and installs and operates great. The price made me think twice about it but after all, it did come with a pretty good sized LCD display. My daughter was very happy with the screen as she was able to put an Ariana Grande video on a loop since she is a huge fan. And here is why I deducted 2 stars from this review. The LCD screen lasted less than 6 months, it completely died. I have another brand screen on my PC and I gave her my screen (from TEMU, haha) and it works great. Put her screen on my PC with the Thermalright software and it won't turn on at all, so definitely a dead screen. Things happen with electronics, so I was just going to go to the Thermalright support webpage to file for an RMA. Well, it turns out that they require a 'serial key' from the box to verify the authenticity of their own product. Well, the box is long gone in the recycle dumpsite of where I live, and with it all hopes of getting this LCD replaced. Lesson learned I guess, these companies make it as difficult as possible for a consumer to get their crappy devices exchanged. A serial key (not serial number, this serial key is behind a scratch off label on the box). Luckily the CPU cooler still works and works very well, quiet and powerful.
